A craft teacher gives each student a square sheet of cardboard of side 24 cm. An open box is to be made by cutting a square of side x cm from each corner and folding up the flaps. The teacher asks the students to make the box that can hold the maximum volume.
(a) Express the volume V of the box in terms of x.
(b) Find dV/dx.
(c) Find the value of x for which the volume is maximum, and find the maximum volume.
OR
(c) Find the values of x for which dV/dx = 0 and explain why one of them cannot be the side of the square that is cut off.

A factory has two machines, A and B. Machine A produces 60% of the items and machine B produces the remaining 40%. It is found that 2% of the items produced by machine A and 1% of the items produced by machine B are defective. An item is picked at random from the day's production.
(a) Find the probability that the item was produced by machine A and is defective.
(b) Find the probability that the item is defective.
(c) If the item is found to be defective, find the probability that it was produced by machine A.
OR
(c) If the item is found to be defective, find the probability that it was produced by machine B.

A bookshop sells Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics guide books. On Monday it sold 10, 8 and 12 copies of the three books respectively, and on Tuesday it sold 6, 10 and 9 copies. The selling prices of the three books are ₹300, ₹250 and ₹400 per copy respectively.
(a) Write the sales of the two days as a matrix with one row for each day, and state its order.
(b) Using matrix multiplication, find the amount collected on Monday.
(c) Find the total amount collected on the two days together.
OR
(c) If the price of each book is increased by 10%, find the amount that would have been collected on Monday.
